description: An open cubby shelf in a toy kitchen holds several clear plastic food containers, including a green-lidded one on the middle shelf and stacked small boxes below. The left hand stays near the cabinet edge while the right hand reaches into the shelves, lifts out a small clear container and sets it on the tabletop, then removes the green-lidded container and places it down, and finally pulls out the remaining larger and smaller clear containers one by one, unstacking them and lining them up on the table to the right.
